title: GRANT/REVOKE 的集合语义模拟与「幽灵权限」陷阱
expected_output:
=== GRANT / REVOKE 的集合语义模拟 ===
初始 权限集合 = []
GRANT SELECT ON shop.* 权限集合 = [('shop', '*', 'SELECT')]
再 GRANT SELECT ON shop.orders 权限集合 = [('shop', '*', 'SELECT'), ('shop', 'orders', 'SELECT')]
此时 SELECT shop.orders 命中 = ['shop.*:SELECT', 'shop.orders:SELECT']
此时 SELECT shop.customers 命中 = ['shop.*:SELECT']
REVOKE SELECT ON shop.* 之后 权限集合 = [('shop', 'orders', 'SELECT')]
REVOKE 后 SELECT shop.orders 命中 = ['shop.orders:SELECT']
REVOKE 后 SELECT shop.customers 命中 = []
坑: 库级授权被回收，但同表的「表级授权」仍在 -> 权限并未真正收回
彻底回收需再执行: REVOKE SELECT ON shop.orders FROM app
两条 REVOKE 都执行后 权限集合 = []
最终 SELECT shop.orders 命中 = []
结论: 权限是「集合的并集」, 回收必须覆盖所有粒度, 否则留下幽灵权限
code:
ACTIONS = ("SELECT", "INSERT", "UPDATE", "DELETE")


def grant(privs, db, table, actions):
    for a in actions:
        privs.add((db, table, a))
    return privs


def revoke(privs, db, table, actions):
    """MySQL 语义: REVOKE 只删除「完全一致」的授权条目。"""
    for a in actions:
        privs.discard((db, table, a))
    return privs


def effective(privs, db, table, action):
    """库级(*)/表级授权共同决定有效权限：任一命中即允许。"""
    hits = []
    for p_db, p_table, p_action in sorted(privs):
        if p_db != db or p_action != action:
            continue
        if p_table == "*" or p_table == table:
            hits.append("%s.%s:%s" % (p_db, p_table, p_action))
    return hits


def show(tag, privs):
    print("%s 权限集合 = %s" % (tag, sorted(privs)))


print("=== GRANT / REVOKE 的集合语义模拟 ===")
privs = set()
show("初始", privs)

grant(privs, "shop", "*", ["SELECT"])
show("GRANT SELECT ON shop.*", privs)

grant(privs, "shop", "orders", ["SELECT"])
show("再 GRANT SELECT ON shop.orders", privs)

print("此时 SELECT shop.orders 命中 =", effective(privs, "shop", "orders", "SELECT"))
print("此时 SELECT shop.customers 命中 =", effective(privs, "shop", "customers", "SELECT"))

revoke(privs, "shop", "*", ["SELECT"])
show("REVOKE SELECT ON shop.* 之后", privs)

print("REVOKE 后 SELECT shop.orders 命中 =", effective(privs, "shop", "orders", "SELECT"))
print("REVOKE 后 SELECT shop.customers 命中 =", effective(privs, "shop", "customers", "SELECT"))
print("坑: 库级授权被回收，但同表的「表级授权」仍在 -> 权限并未真正收回")
print("彻底回收需再执行: REVOKE SELECT ON shop.orders FROM app")

revoke(privs, "shop", "orders", ["SELECT"])
show("两条 REVOKE 都执行后", privs)
print("最终 SELECT shop.orders 命中 =", effective(privs, "shop", "orders", "SELECT"))
print("结论: 权限是「集合的并集」, 回收必须覆盖所有粒度, 否则留下幽灵权限")
